svg.text: ENTERPRISE LLM TPM VS. TPS CONVERSION, LITTLE'S LAW & PTU/GPU CAPACITY PLANNING
Little's Law (B_active = RPS × E2EL) + Weighted Output TPM + P80/P20 Spillover Cuts TCO 65.2%
50K DAU Enterprise Workload (50 Peak RPS, 3.5K In / 500 Out): Tier 1 Avg-Sizing (58.4% 429s) vs. Tier 4 ($134K/mo, 0% 429s)
⛔ Tier 1 Traps: Daily-Avg RPS & Unweighted TPM Math
1. Confusing Per-User TPS (`1/TPOT`) with System TPS (`B × 1/TPOT`):
• Single user sees `62.5 tok/s` (`16ms` TPOT), while a 64-batch
replica delivers `4,000 tok/s` System Output TPS (`240K Out TPM`)
2. Sizing by 24h Average Instead of Peak-to-Avg (`4.8x`) + Little's Law:
• 900K queries/day = `10.4 avg RPS`, but 10:00 AM peak hits `50 RPS`;
at `8.8s` E2EL, `B_active = 50 × 8.8 = 440` concurrent sessions!
3. Ignoring Cloud Output Token Weight (`1 Out Token = 4–8 In Tokens`):
• Treating Input TPM and Output TPM equally starves PTU/GPU decode
Tier 1 Naive Sizing Failure Impact (50 Peak RPS):
• Peak-Hour HTTP 429 & SLA Breach Rate: 58.4%
• P99 End-to-End Latency (E2EL): 34.2s (Queueing explosion!)
• Monthly Capacity & Penalty TCO: $385,000 / month
🏆 Tier 4: Little's Law + Weighted TPM + P80/P20 Hybrid
1. Exact TPM <-> TPS <-> Weighted PTU Conversion:
• `TPM_in = RPS × N_in × 60`, `TPM_out = RPS × N_out × 60`
• `TPM_weighted = TPM_in + w_out × TPM_out` (`w_out = 4 to 6`)
2. Little's Law Concurrency Coupling (`B_active = RPS × E2EL`):
• `B_active = 50 RPS × 8.8s = 440` active KV slots required!
3. P80 Reserved Base (`PTU / Self-Hosted GPU`) + P20 PAYGO Burst:
• Size committed base at 80% of peak (`40 RPS`), overflow 20% to PAYGO
Tier 4 Verified Production Benchmarks:
• Peak-Hour HTTP 429 Rate: 0.0% | P99 E2EL: 8.8s
• Reserved Base Utilization: 86.4% (vs. 38.5% in 100%-Peak Tier 3)
• Monthly Total Capacity TCO: $134,000 / mo (-65.2% vs. Tier 1)
